title: Multiple Choice - Sentence Completion
description: Choose the correct word or phrase to complete the sentence.

questions.text: While the young pianist was performing her solo recital, the audience recognized her remarkable musical __________.
The tech company invested heavily in __________ to build energy-efficient electric aircraft.
After completing secondary school in Manchester, Liam decided to __________ to study astrophysics.
Even when project funding was abruptly cancelled, the environmentalist showed immense __________ to finish planting the trees.
When the film studio released the superhero movie in July, it instantly became an international __________.
The ancient stone fortress overlooking the bay is now a major __________ welcoming thousands of visitors each summer.
King Ferdinand __________ the realm with wisdom and fairness while foreign diplomats were negotiating peace treaties.
Clara was __________ when the university committee awarded her the prestigious international scholarship.
Two engineering students __________ their shared passion for robotics while they were working in the campus laboratory.
Every young researcher hopes to __________ significant scientific breakthroughs that benefit society.
